title: Side Story One: Eustachius's Incognito Operation Downtown
overview: The head priest wants more information on Main, so he sends two of his aides, Eckhard and Eustachius, to investigate her.

title: Side Story Two: Visiting Missus Corinna
overview: Eva and Turi find themselves having to accompany Main to Corinna's residence, because she wants to take a look at the outfit Main wore for her baptism.

title: Re-Ascendance of a Bookworm (1)
overview: Main begins her journey to create paper, facing setbacks and revealing her true self to Lutz.

title: Re-Ascendance of a Bookworm (2)
overview: Main faces challenges as she takes over the orphanage, aiming to help the kids while uncovering dark secrets.
